hook: What Trump, Xi and Putin just agreed
caption:
🤝 Trump, Xi and Putin held their first three-way summit in Shenzhen and adopted a four-point peace declaration.
⚠️ Iran widened attacks to Kuwait and Bahrain after a US strike on Qeshm Island. Americans in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain: check the latest State Department warnings.
🪖 Israel's first major Gaza ground raid since the ceasefire ended after one day.
🌉 Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge for the third time this week.
🐦 Peru freed rescued pelicans as its first state marine wildlife centre opened.
Can a three-way summit actually change anything? Tell us below 👇
Follow @you.didnot.know for the daily brief.

📷 NASA (Public domain) via wikimedia · Alexxx1979 (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia · Havardtl (CC BY 4.0) via wikimedia

1/5 First US-China-Russia summit (1st)
Trump, Xi and Putin held their first three-way summit. They adopted a four-point 'declaration of peace'.
🎨 AI-generated image

2/5 Iran widens Gulf attacks (Kuwait)
Iran targeted a Kuwait air base and sites in Bahrain. It followed a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island.
📷 NASA (Public domain) via wikimedia

3/5 Israeli tanks raid central Gaza (1 day)
Israel launched its first major Gaza raid since the ceasefire. Hamas calls it a flagrant ceasefire violation.
🎨 AI-generated image

4/5 Crimean Bridge hit again (3rd)
Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge for a third time this week. It links Russia to Crimea, annexed by Russia in 2014.
📷 Alexxx1979 (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

5/5 Peru frees rescued pelicans (100)
Peru released rescued pelicans after a month of care. It opened Peru's first state marine wildlife centre.
📷 Havardtl (CC BY 4.0) via wikimedia
